newsitem.title: UK: Turkey buys 75,000 tonnes gas oil by Oct 15 - trade. [Corrected 18:35 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Turkey buys 75,000 tonnes gas oil by Oct 15 - trade. [Corrected 18:35 gmt]

text.p: Turkish state oil company Tupras has bought 75,000 tonnes of 0.5 percent sulphur gas oil for delivery by October 15 in its latest tender, traders said on Friday.

The tender for delivery to Izmit was awarded to Onyx with 25,000 tonnes at around fob high +$10; Agip with 25,000 tonnes at around fob high +$9; and Baycor with 25,000 tonnes at around fob high +$9, they said (corrects to fob from cif throughout).
